shared_elements: low-relief carved detail on a flat surface
patterned/striated texture (fleece in A, incised bands in B)
justification: Both depict human forms and include roundel/disc motifs carved in relief, but that is about as generic as correspondences get: A shows a narrative procession of profile figures leading horned rams past a tree, framed above and below by continuous rosette borders, while B is a single frontal, blocky anthropomorphic figure whose surface bears isolated abstract signs (rings, curved bands, appendage-like shapes) with no scene, no animals and no register framing. The manner of depiction also differs sharply: fine, detailed, naturalistic profile carving with dense patterned infill versus massive, schematic, frontal body with sparse incised symbols.
